verdict.rationale: Proa is a UI framework with signals in hydrated islands, so testing reactive state without rendering the DOM is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a way to unit test signals or logic in isolation. Compile-time template validation, build-time WCAG checks, `--deny warnings` lints and `proa fmt --verify` are related quality controls, not unit testing of reactive state.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM
